item.title: French court blocks Macron’s social media ban for under-15s
item.description: France’s Constitutional Council has blocked a bill that would have banned social media access for under-15s, ruling that it infringed on freedom of expression. item.title: In 2017, conservationists began moving young ospreys from Scotland to Dorset
item.description: Conservationists successfully reintroduced ospreys to Dorset, England, after a century-long absence. A study revealed pioneering pairs are crucial for rapid species expansion into new territories. These birds establish separate breeding groups, accelerating population growth significantly. Translocation projects create artificial pioneers, saving decades of natural recolonisation time. New osprey populations are now spreading, connecting southern England with other established areas. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Government launches investigation into potential unsafe practices at Spanish healthcare company Grifols A chain of private plasma donation clinics in Canada has said it is pausing collections after the deaths of two donors and a new government investigation into potential unsafe practices. Grifols, a Spanish healthcare company which runs 17 clinics in Canada and is the country’s only private clinic for plasma donation, said it informed Health Canada of its decision to temporarily pause collections on Wednesday. item.title: Brasil: la lluvia dicta el menú en un restaurante de tres estrellas en São Paulo
item.description: Este restaurante ha hecho una apuesta audaz: adaptar su cocina al cambio climático. Aquí, en el restaurante Tuju, el menú cambia en función del régimen de lluvias, cada vez más irregular en la metrópoli de São Paulo. A lo largo del año, se sirven cuatro menús diferentes titulados: humedad, lluvia, viento y sequía. Lejos de seguir estrictamente el ritmo de las estaciones, se sirven en función de las precipitaciones. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
